data: Speak messages from a voice channel's text chat aloud, with personal voices, accents, regions, and nicknames.
Built for mutes and talkers alike.
Read messages from the chat attached to your current voice channel.
Choose an accent and region, then save them as your defaults.
Start autoread, speak one message, or skip messages whenever you need.
Choose how Voicely Text refers to you across Discord or in one server.
